record.bible_text: Say<WH0559><WTH8798> ye unto your brethren<WH0251>, Ammi<WH05971>; and to your sisters<WH0269>, Ruhamah<WH07355><WTH8795>. <RF>Ammi: that is, My people<Rf> <RF>Ruhamah: that is, Having obtained mercy<Rf>

Plead<WH07378><WTH8798> with your mother<WH0517>, plead<WH07378><WTH8798>: for she <FI>is<Fi> not my wife<WH0802>, neither <FI>am<Fi> I her husband<WH0376>: let her therefore put away<WH05493><WTH8686> her whoredoms<WH02183> out of her sight<WH06440>, and her adulteries<WH05005> from between her breasts<WH07699>;

Lest I strip<WH06584><WTH8686> her naked<WH06174>, and set<WH03322><WTH8689> her as in the day<WH03117> that she was born<WH03205><WTH8736>, and make<WH07760><WTH8804> her as a wilderness<WH04057>, and set<WH07896><WTH8804> her like a dry<WH06723> land<WH0776>, and slay<WH04191><WTH8689> her with thirst<WH06772>.
And I will not have mercy<WH07355><WTH8762> upon her children<WH01121>; for they <FI>be<Fi> the children<WH01121> of whoredoms<WH02183>.

For their mother<WH0517> hath played the harlot<WH02181><WTH8804>: she that conceived<WH02029><WTH8802> them hath done shamefully<WH03001><WTH8689>: for she said<WH0559><WTH8804>, I will go<WH03212><WTH8799> after<WH0310> my lovers<WH0157><WTH8764>, that give<WH05414><WTH8802> <FI>me<Fi> my bread<WH03899> and my water<WH04325>, my wool<WH06785> and my flax<WH06593>, mine oil<WH08081> and my drink<WH08250>. <RF>drink: Heb. drinks<Rf><CM>

Therefore, behold, I will hedge<WH07753><WTH8801> up thy way<WH01870> with thorns<WH05518>, and make<WH01443><WTH8804> a wall<WH01447>, that she shall not find<WH04672><WTH8799> her paths<WH05410>. <RF>make...: Heb. wall a wall<Rf>

And she shall follow<WH07291><WTH8765> after her lovers<WH0157><WTH8764>, but she shall not overtake<WH05381><WTH8686> them; and she shall seek<WH01245><WTH8765> them, but shall not find<WH04672><WTH8799> <FI>them<Fi> : then shall she say<WH0559><WTH8804>, I will go<WH03212><WTH8799> and return<WH07725><WTH8799> to my first<WH07223> husband<WH0376>; for then <FI>was it<Fi> better<WH02896> with me than now<WH06258>.

For she did not know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I gave<WH05414><WTH8804> her corn<WH01715>, and wine<WH08492>, and oil<WH03323>, and multiplied<WH07235><WTH8689> her silver<WH03701> and gold<WH02091>, <FI>which<Fi>  they prepared<WH06213><WTH8804> for Baal<WH01168>. <RF>wine: Heb. new wine<Rf> <RF>which...: or, wherewith they made Baal<Rf>

Therefore will I return<WH07725><WTH8799>, and take away<WH03947><WTH8804> my corn<WH01715> in the time<WH06256> thereof, and my wine<WH08492> in the season<WH04150> thereof, and will recover<WH05337><WTH8689> my wool<WH06785> and my flax<WH06593> <FI> given<Fi> to cover<WH03680><WTH8763> her nakedness<WH06172>. <RF>recover: or, take away<Rf>

And now will I discover<WH01540><WTH8762> her lewdness<WH05040> in the sight<WH05869> of her lovers<WH0157><WTH8764>, and none<WH0376> shall deliver<WH05337><WTH8686> her out of mine hand<WH03027>. <RF>lewdness: Heb. folly, or, villany<Rf>
I will also cause all her mirth<WH04885> to cease<WH07673><WTH8689>, her feast days<WH02282>, her new moons<WH02320>, and her sabbaths<WH07676>, and all her solemn feasts<WH04150>.

And I will destroy<WH08074><WTH8689> her vines<WH01612> and her fig trees<WH08384>, whereof she hath said<WH0559><WTH8804>, These <FI>are<Fi> my rewards<WH0866> that my lovers<WH0157><WTH8764> have given<WH05414><WTH8804> me: and I will make<WH07760><WTH8804> them a forest<WH03293>, and the beasts<WH02416> of the field<WH07704> shall eat<WH0398><WTH8804> them. <RF>destroy: Heb. make desolate<Rf>

And I will visit<WH06485><WTH8804> upon her the days<WH03117> of Baalim<WH01168>, wherein she burned incense<WH06999><WTH8686> to them, and she decked<WH05710><WTH8799> herself with her earrings<WH05141> and her jewels<WH02484>, and she went<WH03212><WTH8799> after<WH0310> her lovers<WH0157><WTH8764>, and forgat<WH07911><WTH8804> me, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>.<CM>

Therefore, behold, I will allure<WH06601><WTH8764> her, and bring<WH03212><WTH8689> her into the wilderness<WH04057>, and speak<WH01696><WTH8765> comfortably<WH03820> unto her. <RF>comfortably: or, friendly: Heb. to her heart<Rf>

And I will give<WH05414><WTH8804> her her vineyards<WH03754> from thence, and the valley<WH06010> of Achor<WH05911> for a door<WH06607> of hope<WH08615>: and she shall sing<WH06030><WTH8804> there, as in the days<WH03117> of her youth<WH05271>, and as in the day<WH03117> when she came up<WH05927><WTH8800> out of the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>.

And it shall be at that day<WH03117>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>, <FI>that<Fi> thou shalt call<WH07121><WTH8799> me Ishi<WH0376>; and shalt call<WH07121><WTH8799> me no more Baali<WH01180>. <RF>Ishi: that is, My husband<Rf> <RF>Baali: that is, My lord<Rf>
For I will take away<WH05493><WTH8689> the names<WH08034> of Baalim<WH01168> out of her mouth<WH06310>, and they shall no more be remembered<WH02142><WTH8735> by their name<WH08034>.

And in that day<WH03117> will I make<WH03772><WTH8804> a covenant<WH01285> for them with the beasts<WH02416> of the field<WH07704>, and with the fowls<WH05775> of heaven<WH08064>, and <FI>with<Fi> the creeping things<WH07431> of the ground<WH0127>: and I will break<WH07665><WTH8799> the bow<WH07198> and the sword<WH02719> and the battle<WH04421> out of the earth<WH0776>, and will make them to lie down<WH07901><WTH8689> safely<WH0983>.

And I will betroth<WH0781><WTH8765> thee unto me for ever<WH05769>; yea, I will betroth<WH0781><WTH8765> thee unto me in righteousness<WH06664>, and in judgment<WH04941>, and in lovingkindness<WH02617>, and in mercies<WH07356>.
I will even betroth<WH0781><WTH8765> thee unto me in faithfulness<WH0530>: and thou shalt know<WH03045><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>.

And it shall come to pass in that day<WH03117>, I will hear<WH06030><WTH8799>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>, I will hear<WH06030><WTH8799> the heavens<WH08064>, and they shall hear<WH06030><WTH8799> the earth<WH0776>;
And the earth<WH0776> shall hear<WH06030><WTH8799> the corn<WH01715>, and the wine<WH08492>, and the oil<WH03323>; and they shall hear<WH06030><WTH8799> Jezreel<WH03157>.

And I will sow<WH02232><WTH8804> her unto me in the earth<WH0776>; and I will have mercy<WH07355><WTH8765> upon her that had not obtained mercy<WH07355><WTH8795><WTH8677><WH03818>; and I will say<WH0559><WTH8804> to <FI>them which were<Fi> not my people<WH05971>, Thou <FI>art<Fi> my people<WH05971>; and they shall say<WH0559><WTH8799>, <FI>Thou art<Fi> my God<WH0430>.<CM>
